en: Black‑and‑white winter view over a mountainous, forested valley with deep conifer woods and snow‑covered slopes. In the foreground and mid‑distance stand several large chalet‑style hotels or sanatorium buildings with steep roofs and dormers, typical of Central European spa or ski resorts. A winding road and scattered villas run along the valley floor. The surrounding mountains are densely forested, with one broad cleared strip on a slope that resembles an early ski run. At the very top edge of the image, some reversed handwritten numbers and characters are visible on the film border.
